historical_quarantine.policy: Old fragment matches, proposed keys, rosters, repaired phrases and answer-specific extraction choices are not active targets or validation criteria.
historical_quarantine.reuse_condition: Only reconsider an old result if an independently specified construction and selection rule reproduces it. Do not choose parameters to recover it.

acceptance_requirements: Record clue basis and parameter choices before running a proposed body extraction.
Define the recovered object type and population; it need not be English prose.
Specify what makes one object the outlier before reading its candidate answer.
Check the claimed construction forward, including reversibility where applicable.
Validate nontrivial predictions or structure beyond a short recognizable word.
Keep exploratory hypotheses distinct from author statements and literal source observations.

hypotheses.wire_hypothesis: Each unsigned bit pattern is A0 positional base26, most-significant letter first, padded with A to ceil(bits/log2(26)) letters: count7, key14, checksum7. Counts use signed32 two’s complement. No official serializer is attributed to the reference.

hypotheses.name: Exact binary-prefix invariants under arbitrary digit relabelling
hypotheses.basis: Execute the representation-first gate left after R13, without adding a semantic keyword or a letterwise encryption. This is exploratory model testing, not an author-confirmed encoding.
hypotheses.model: Each original glyph maps bijectively to a digit of a whole base26 integer; test digits0..25 and bijective digits1..26. Big-endian minimal bytes only. Fixed-width zero-leading numeral allowed conservatively; separately count canonical zero-free A0 numerals.

prefix_families.gzip: 1f8b08 followed by all32 legal flag bytes; remaining header fields unrestricted
prefix_families.zlib: All CM=8, CINFO0..7, FCHECK-valid two-byte headers; FDICT and FLEVEL unrestricted
prefix_families.bzip2: BZh1..9 followed by either the first-block or empty-stream 48-bit marker
prefix_families.xz: Six-byte stream magic only; flags and checksum unrestricted

hypotheses.method: Count all injective glyph/digit assignments consistent with integer intervals for a prefix at each feasible minimal byte length. Fully included prefix subtrees contribute factorial completions; repeated-glyph and all-different constraints prune boundaries. No alphabet enumeration cap or heuristic cutoff.
hypotheses.gate: A zero count excludes only this raw representation and header family. A positive count is prefix compatibility, not a decoded packet, recovered population, or outlier. A deterministic completion is a compatibility witness only.
hypotheses.controls: Compare exact counts with exhaustive small-alphabet permutations; recover known relabelled compressed-header controls; check fixed mappings, bijective bias, leading-zero conventions and boundary inclusivity.

outcome.independent_certificate: All permitted first-six-digit prefixes contradict equality/injectivity for source VXGFAG, or lie outside the numeral range. Independently checked without the interval counter.
outcome.caution: Zlib header-only witnesses are arbitrary completions, not recovered alphabets or validated packets.

hypotheses.name: Little-endian whole-numeral header congruences under arbitrary digit relabelling
hypotheses.basis: Complete the byte-order distinction explicitly left open by R14; no new semantic key, literary population, or letter-stage cipher.
hypotheses.models: Original order; full/drop final I; arbitrary bijective glyph mapping to0..25 or1..26; minimal little-endian integer bytes. A0 zero-leading numeral permitted as in the broader R14 model. For checksum validation of a SAT witness, separately restore0..7 lost trailing zero bytes, as in the earlier whole-integer models; these do not change a header already inside the minimal bytes.
hypotheses.header_families: Exactly the R14 header catalog: all32 gzip flags, all66 valid zlib headers, all18 bzip2 block/empty prefixes, XZ six-byte magic. One disjunction per family, not a preferred header.
hypotheses.method: SMT bit-vector constraints: AllDifferent digits in0..25; sum of modular positional coefficients plus bias equals an admitted little-endian header residue modulo2**(8*header_bytes). Older terms divisible by the modulus vanish. Enforce minimal byte representation long enough to contain the header.
hypotheses.classification: SAT: verify the complete alphabet and header in independent Python arithmetic, then check this one arbitrary completion for a bounded checksum-valid origin-zero compressed stream consuming all bytes. UNSAT: excludes that header family/model. UNKNOWN or timeout: untested feasibility, never a negative.

validation_limits.preset_dictionary: none supplied; a dictionary-required witness is not accepted as a complete stream

hypotheses.limits: No enumeration of all SAT mappings, no model counting, no inference from a lone header; a failing arbitrary witness does not eliminate other maps. SAT alphabets are compatibility witnesses, not recovered keys.
hypotheses.controls: Exhaust small-alphabet permutations against solver SAT/UNSAT; compare modular coefficients with scalar full numerals; known relabelled compressed members; minimal-byte length, bias, exact source roundtrip and timeout-state handling.

outcome.unknown_reason: All four bzip2 queries reached the solver timeout. Feasibility remains unresolved.
outcome.caution: One arbitrary completion per SAT query, not an exhaustive search of compatible alphabets. No payload or population is established.

hypotheses.name: Whole gzip packet with one stored DEFLATE block
hypotheses.basis: R15 shows header-only feasibility is underdetermined. Test a complete low-complexity gzip construction, including the far-end length and CRC, without choosing a keyword. Stored DEFLATE is a standard wrapper for incompressible binary data, not an author-confirmed layer.
hypotheses.models: Raw original glyph order, full/drop final I, arbitrary bijection to0..25 or1..26, whole integer to minimal little-endian bytes, restore0..7 trailing zero bytes. Same alphabet class as R14/R15; no other cipher or book stage.

gzip_scope.header: Exactly ten bytes: magic1f8b, CM8, FLG0 (no optional fields); MTIME, XFL and OS bytes unrestricted.
gzip_scope.deflate: One final stored block: BFINAL1, BTYPE00, any ignored alignment bits, LEN/NLEN complementary; nonempty payload at most65535bytes.
gzip_scope.trailer: CRC32 of the entire stored payload and ISIZE equal to payload length. Must consume every packet byte.
gzip_scope.size_rule: Packet overhead23bytes. For each feasible minimal-byte length n and restoration z in0..7, payload length L=n+z-23. Require the ISIZE trailer to have exactly z trailing zero bytes. Its remaining bytes constrain the high end of the numeral.

hypotheses.method: Convert the high-end ISIZE interval to an exact disjoint cover of glyph/digit prefix assignments; combine that cover with low120-bit gzip/stored-block constraints in SMT. Enumerate distinct numeral-producing assignments, independently reconstruct each whole packet, check grammar, CRC32, ISIZE and bounded decompression.
hypotheses.classification: A verified full packet is a recovery candidate, not an assigned population/outlier. An empty exact interval cover or solver exhaustion with all CRC failures excludes only this stored-block/FLG0 class in that case. Timeout or candidate cap is incomplete, never an exclusion.
hypotheses.excluded: Other DEFLATE block types, multiple blocks, optional gzip fields, multiple members, larger payloads, other wrappers, other byte order, reversed digits, extra letter ciphers, arbitrary offsets, passwords and book transformations.
hypotheses.controls: Exhaust small-alphabet interval covers; positive hand-built valid gzip/stored controls with independent library decoding under both digit biases; CRC corruption, NLEN corruption and nonfinal-block negatives; timeout/cap classifications; exact input roundtrip and source-overwrite guard.

outcome.scope_note: All drop-final-I cases excluded for the registered single stored-block gzip class. Full body5133byte A0/A1 cases remain unresolved; no actual-source CRC candidate was produced. Positive CRC recovery is demonstrated by synthetic controls only.

hypotheses.name: Independent backend check of unresolved R16 packet constraints
hypotheses.basis: R16 remains unresolved in two full-body cases; change computational backend, not cipher/alphabet/header/payload hypotheses. R16 results and original30second budgets remain unchanged.
hypotheses.inputs: Only the two R16 UNKNOWN cases, selected from its recorded report after verifying the original-source hash and derived length cases.
hypotheses.constraints: Use exactly the R16 stored-gzip query builder; export standard SMT-LIB and parse into cvc5. Same interval cover, bijection, low120-bit fields, length, CRC validation and distinct-numeral blocking.
hypotheses.budget_note: This is a separately registered second-backend experiment, not a change to the first experiment or a relabelled timeout. No further budget escalation in this pass.
hypotheses.classification: Only completed exhaustion with all candidates independently CRC-rejected proves an exclusion. A timeout or cap remains incomplete. A verified packet must pass the full parser/decompressor and original-letter roundtrip; population/outlier remain unassigned.
hypotheses.controls: Use the same positive full-packet fixtures and CRC-corrupt/candidate-cap controls through the adapter; verify incremental SMT parsing and model values.

outcome.interpretation: Both independently budgeted cvc5 cases remain UNKNOWN. No extension to R16 exclusions, recovered alphabet, packet, population or outlier.

one confirmed layer per poem line
all body letters decode to prose

historical_negatives: Keep their documented scopes. Do not repeat unchanged searches or treat them as proof that all other constructions fail.
next_gate: Do not escalate these solver budgets again without a separately justified experiment. Before another body search, require a clue-grounded forward construction or exact representation invariant with a discriminating prediction; preserve both unresolved cases and all scoped exclusions.
